items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: John used to --he used to hang around and the gals used to say, get rid of him

ctx.x: But you sure copied a lot of -- tell us something about your relationship with Duke, since we're into this thing about your eyes, because you and him were pretty close.

Oh, yes, I used to answer all his mail and sometimes I'd get a letter, somebody would say hey, Duke, we got some girls here, come on. Shall I call them up. Yeah, call them up. And I remember in Detroit, Michigan, we had Al, what's his name, the manager. John used to --he used to hang around and the gals used to say, get rid of him and I said,
I'll see you all later, go on and leave.
